messages:
laura: Quick question 11 we keep losing partner visibility on warm marketplace leads (they go straight to AE). Can we define a lightweight SI intake 'stamp' + routing so partners get notified and can claim?
mike: Minimal CRM stamp proposal: source=marketplace, partner_flag=si_candidate, partner_owner_hint, joint_announce_intent. Then a 24h claim window.
asha: 24h claim SLA sounds good. If unclaimed, auto-assign to partner-queue (pilot option). For urgent or high-ARR accounts, bypass auto-assign and notify AE + partner immediately.
ben-salesops: Automation plan: 1) marketplace webhook creates lead with stamp; 2) apply tags + ARR banding; 3) start 24h timer; 4) send partner_offer webhook; 5) on partner_ack -> assign; on partner_decline -> fallback routing. I will draft the runbook.
priya-silead: Add account mapping: domain heuristics + ARR band to choose enterprise vs midmarket SI lanes. ARR >250k -> human triage (2h SLA). Also flag hw_interest early for hardware partner ops.
chad-gtm: Add joint_announce checkbox on intake so GTM can prep messaging early for co-marketable/PR opportunities.
marketplace-bot: New marketplace lead created: lead_id=MP-12190, org=Greenleaf.ai, arr_est=350000, tags=[marketplace,needs-si]
laura: Ben, can you own the automation + Confluence doc (intake webhook schema, partner_ack endpoint, fallback rules)? I'll run partner ops and pilot coordination.
ben-salesops: Yup. Draft by EOD tomorrow. Sample webhook payload I'll include: {"lead_id":"MP-12190","source":"marketplace","partner_hint":"greenleaf-int","arr_est":350000,"joint_announce_intent":false}
asha: Routing rules: ARR>250k -> enterprise-si bucket; 100k-250k -> regional AE + partner notify; <100k -> partner nurture/self-serve.
priya-silead: Also add hw_order and nda_required flags so partner-ops/legal get looped and SLA pauses until NDA.
mike: I'll update the intake form to add fields: joint_announce_intent, hw_order, nda_required, partner_hint.
priya-silead: Can partners accept/decline via partner portal webhook? If partners can decline, we won't waste AE time.
ben-salesops: Plan: POST /partner/offer -> partner posts /partner/ack or /partner/decline -> CRM updates routing. We'll include partner_bandwidth metadata to avoid spamming overloaded partners.
chad-gtm: Rollout: pilot with 3 SIs + marketplace sellers next week. Need analytics: time to claim, ack rate, conversion. Who volunteers?
priya-silead: I'll coordinate AtlasOne + Symmetry; propose Clearpath as third.
laura: Pilot locked: AtlasOne, Symmetry, Clearpath. Ben add pilot flag and analytics events. Reconvene after 1 week to review metrics.
ben-salesops: Added pilot flag + event tracking + sample dashboard metrics. Will post Confluence link when draft is ready. :thumbsup:
marketplace-bot: Automation engaged (pilot mode): intake MP-12190 routed to partner-queue.
laura: Thanks everyone 1 action items: Ben runbook + Confluence, Priya partner coordination, Mike intake form changes, Pilot next week. Tagging @chad-gtm for GTM readiness.
